linkRelationship (string or DefinedTerm) mapped to a DS_AssociationTypeCode (isPartOf largerWorkCitation, isBasedOn dependency, ...; else crossReference); target URL as the citation's online resource.
A 'FUNDING: ' line: each grant's name (else description), (funder: name) and [identifier].
A 'MEASUREMENT TECHNIQUE: ' line.
A 'PUBLISHING PRINCIPLES: ' line.
A 'VARIABLES MEASURED: ' line: name (unit) [min..max]. The lines are joined into one supplementalInformation.

An MD_FeatureCatalogue holding one FC_FeatureType named by the dataset, one FC_FeatureAttribute per variable: name the memberName, description the definition, propertyID the code, unitText (else unitCode) the valueMeasurementUnit, cdif:hasIntendedDataType the valueType; minValue, maxValue and unitCode as constrainedBy key: value pairs. versionDate is datePublished, else dateModified (fromJsonCdif.xsl used the conversion date).
Each distinct format of the top-level distributions as a format specification citation title.
A CI_Individual for a Person, else a CI_Organisation; role distributor. Written before transferOptions, as the schema orders them (fromJsonCdif.xsl wrote them after).

One MD_DigitalTransferOptions per distribution with a contentUrl: cdif:fileSize (in cdif:fileSizeUofM) as transferSize in MB; the contentUrl an online resource (protocol from its scheme, name, description with [characterSet: ...]); each named hasPart an online resource at the OGC nil URI inapplicable, function information.
When no distribution has a contentUrl, the landing page as the one online resource.
A DQ_DataQuality (scope dataset) with one DQ_UsabilityElement per measurement: isMeasurementOf the nameOfMeasure, value the descriptive result statement.
The activities' descriptions (else names), joined with '; '. With no provenance, an empty statement (resourceLineage is always written).
Each source's description (else name, else @id), with a citation titled by its name, at its URL or http @id. A lineage with sources or steps has scope dataset.
Each activity a process step: description (else name), endTime as stepDateTime, each prov:used a source.
